title: Finding Places on a Small Campus
instructions: 阅读短文，完成8个题目。短文和题目均为英语，解释为中文。所有内容为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。请先读短文，再做题。答案必须来自短文。
passage: A: This is a small campus. There is a library. There are two cafes. The library is next to the cafe. There is a gym behind the library. There are three classrooms in the gym. B: Look! A student is running. She is running to the gym. Two teachers are walking to the cafe. They are talking. C: Please sit down. Please open your book. Don't run in the library. The library is quiet. There is a map on the wall. The map is near the door. There are four bikes outside. The bikes are in front of the library.

grammar.title: There is / There are; 地点介词; 现在进行时; 祈使句入门
grammar.explanation: 我们用 there is 表示“有一个”，后面接单数名词；用 there are 表示“有多个”，后面接复数名词。地点介词如 next to（在……旁边）、behind（在……后面）、in front of（在……前面）、on（在……上面）、near（在……附近）用来描述位置。现在进行时表示正在发生的动作，结构是 be（am/is/are）+ 动词-ing，例如 is running, are walking。祈使句用来发出指令或请求，动词原形开头，例如 Please sit down. 否定祈使句用 Don't + 动词原形，例如 Don't run.
grammar.example: There is a library. There are two cafes. The library is next to the cafe. A student is running. Please sit down. Don't run in the library.

questions.prompt: There ______ a book on the desk.
questions.explanation: book 是单数，所以用 there is。

questions.prompt: There ______ two pens in my bag.
questions.explanation: two pens 是复数，所以用 there are。

questions.prompt: The cat is ______ the table. (The cat is under the table.)
questions.evidence: There is a gym behind the library.

questions.prompt: The bank is ______ the shop. (The bank is behind the shop.)
questions.explanation: 银行在商店后面，用 behind。
questions.evidence: There is a gym behind the library.

questions.explanation: boy 是第三人称单数，现在进行时用 is + 动词-ing。

questions.prompt: The girls ______ in the park now.
questions.explanation: girls 是复数，现在进行时用 are + 动词-ing。
questions.evidence: Two teachers are walking to the cafe.

questions.explanation: 表示请求用 Please + 动词原形。
否定祈使句用 Don't + 动词原形。
